title: Qualify live exact-commit task closure and stale review
description: Mechanics for Closes trailers, resumed assignments, stale owner requests and manager review are tested. Prove real specialist commit naming and interrupted landed-closure reconciliation in the approved self-host trial before enabling automatic closure or self-claim.
acceptanceCriteria: Closes intent alone cannot complete work; exact landing and policy receipts are required
Recovery is idempotent and unrelated tasks remain open
Stale reviews distinguish missing history from proven inactivity and do not auto-restart blocked work
